arrangement.notes: Boom Bap aranjmanı, minimal varyasyonlu, duygusal bir atmosferde, kulüp enerjisi profiliyle. Modern sample chopping teknikleri kullanılarak örnek katmanı oluşturuldu. Kanal isimleri sample parçalama tekniklerinden esinlenilmiştir.

Slice Transient.description: Primary drum chops using transient slicing

Beat Repeat.description: Looped sample chopping for rhythmic consistency

Stutter Gate.description: Chopped stutter effect on samples for dynamic texture

Reverse Grab.description: Reverse chopped samples for emotional club energy

sound_intent.description: Create an emotional Boom Bap arrangement with minimal variations using modern sample chopping techniques to produce a club energy profile suitable for underground hip hop venues.

routing_intent.description: Route sample chop based drum layers through transient slicing techniques, chords and FX layers with stutter gating and reverse grabs for emotional intensity and club vibe.

track_roles.drums: core rhythm and groove using chopped samples
track_roles.melody: sparse melodic motifs using chopped samples
track_roles.fx: sample chop effects to enhance transitions and texture

designer_intent.goal: Maintain emotional impact and club energy while using minimal variation and modern chopping sample layers.

presetor_intent.goal: Enable bypassing temporary arrangement changes for clean audio rendering during production.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum parts using modern sample chopping techniques based on transient slicing and minimal variation to support emotional club energy.

bass_generator.brief: Create supportive bass lines that reinforce groove and emotional mood without overpowering the minimal arrangement.

harmony_generator.brief: Develop chordal textures using chopped sample layers with subtle rhythmic elements to enhance emotional atmosphere.

melody_generator.brief: Add sparse melodic elements using chopped samples minimizing complexity to maintain minimal variation and club energy.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement energy curve, section transitions, and ensure emotional cohesion using sample chopping approaches.

presetor.brief: Manage arrangement-presets to ensure bypass of temporary changes for consistent rendering workflow.

songgps.brief: Monitor arrangement structure, section markers, and energy profiles to keep arrangement aligned with emotional Boom Bap club style.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Receive unprocessed channel audio and prepare mixes emphasizing sample chop clarity and emotional impact in club environment.
